summary: Unity-namespace squat beacons host identifiers to webhook.site on install
details: Package name mimics the Unity `com.unity.*` namespace while its contents are unrelated. `package.json` declares `postinstall: node index.js`, and on `npm install` the script reads `os.hostname()` and `process.cwd()` and POSTs them, together with a generated UUID and an `authorized-poc-test` event marker, to the hardcoded collector `https://webhook.site/6fc1b78a-5046-4192-abc9-edf993a31b33`. The shape — namespace squat + automatic install-time beacon of host identifiers to a third-party webhook collector — is dependency-confusion reconnaissance: installer hostnames and working-directory paths leak to an attacker-controlled endpoint without user consent, and the same channel can be used to identify viable internal-build targets for follow-on attacks.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
